title: Tyler's claimed time-travel group with Townsend Brown in NASA and the Bahamas

as_told.title: Tim Taylor's secret time travel group out of Nassau

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor is said to have told Ryan Bledsoe, the son of Chris Bledsoe, a man known for reporting many UFO encounters, that he belonged to a secret time travel group based at NASA and in Nassau in the Bahamas, run by the mid-century anti-gravity inventor Thomas Townsend Brown. Michels repeats this again and again across many episodes, citing a Twitter post by the son, the documentary Launch Fever, and the scholar Diana Pasulka's book American Cosmic, and the details shift: sometimes it is NASA, sometimes only Nassau, and in one version the time travel is only "insinuated". If true, it would tie Brown's anti-gravity work to a hidden time travel effort.
